title: Managing and Rotating API Keys
content: API keys are used for agent data ingestion and programmatic API access. You can manage API keys in Settings → API Keys. To rotate an API key safely: Step 1: Generate a new secondary key in the console. Step 2: Deploy the secondary key to your agents or scripts. Step 3: Monitor incoming metrics traffic in the console to ensure the secondary key is being active. Step 4: Revoke the old primary key. We recommend rotating API keys every 90 days to maintain high security standards and reduce exposure risk. You can also specify restrictive CIDR bounds on each key to limit source IP access.
